# Intro

## About the data

-Water sample data from arctic Ocean

-Data downladed for Arctic Data Center [Tweedi ADC data](https://arcticdata.io/catalog/view/doi:10.18739/A25T3FZ8X)

## Set up

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(readr)
library(here)
```

## read in the data


```{r}
#| warning: false
bg_chem <- read_csv(here("data/BGchem2008data.csv"))
```

# Analysis

## Calculate sats
```{r}
# print colum names
colnames(bg_chem)

# show data structure
str(bg_chem)

# first bit of the data
head(bg_chem)

#summary of each colum

summary(bg_chem)

# get unicq valuse
unique(bg_chem$Date)
```


## Calculate mean
```{r}
#calulate some means
nitrate <- mean(bg_chem$NO3)

nitrite <- mean(bg_chem$NO2)

amm <- mean(bg_chem$NH4)

phos <- mean(bg_chem$P)
```





## Plot

```{r}
ratio <- (nitrate+nitrite+ amm)/ phos
```

Here is the ratio we calculated: `r round(ratio, 3)`
